retry() returns false whenever ctx has ended, without setting readErr, and readErr is cleared at :564 before each read. So a claimed role's handover whose 10-minute window ends during a slow read (a stalled JetStream request waits up to roleKeepDrainWindow, 60 s, longer than the 30 s cap on pauses) ends reporting nothing above Debug. The same failure ending during a pause is logged at Error. Make only cancellation quiet: errors.Is(ctx.Err(), context.Canceled), or keep the previous pass's readErr when the deadline cuts the read. Correct :497-498 and AGENTS.md:2420, and add a row whose stalled read outlasts a short window.

role_keep.go is 1010 lines, over the 1000-line rule, and all 11 new lines are comments. The retry rule is written four times (:90-95, :487-499, :531-536, AGENTS.md:2420), which is how round-7 minor 1 drifted. State it once in handOverKeptRole's doc and point to it from the others.
The 'copy is still kept' check reads the newest kept message, which no handover path deletes, so it cannot fail. Check that the cursor or the forward count did not change, or drop it.
Lines 491-509 are a third copy of claimRoleBeyondTheSessionCache (:676). Let the helper take several roles and call it here.

This puts a failed walk under the cached-claim rule, but a failed walk retries without checking the claim and ends at Error. Also, the item at :2409 ('A role send has three answers') now also holds the handover and sweep sentences (:2417-2427): start a new item there. A walk that a shutdown cancels still logs at Error (role_keep.go:868-870, :874-876), which the PR body's shutdown line does not cover; either make it quiet with the same Canceled check or narrow the PR body's claim.
